description: Called Nick to the lute, and held him to Saturday's note.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Marked the book and both rolls, signed the corner, and did not open the chest.
name: Humphrey Larkham

description: Asked for the clearer lead, and went to the lute without singing the cue.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Doubted the need, tried the cue, and said it was better.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Took the laugh that was already written, and did not ask for another.
name: Will Kemp

description: Played, unnamed the part, and wrote no new line.
name: William Shakespeare
